title: Death on the Nile
author: Agatha Christie
summary: A glamorous heiress on her honeymoon is shadowed by a jilted ex-friend, and then turns up dead on a Nile steamer full of people with reasons to resent her. Hercule Poirot is on board.
readIf: you like glamorous, sun-baked mysteries with a big cast of suspects and sharp character sketches.
skipIf: you want a fast pace from the start, because the set-up takes a while before the crime.

pairings.reason: A modern mystery with a similar glamorous gathering, hidden grudges and a body.
Another story of love and resentment around a beautiful woman, with a more brooding and gothic atmosphere.
A young-adult mystery that mirrors the classic clue-gathering style with a modern teenage detective.
